title: A Green Sea
summary: You took Kehlenn's offer as the moon fell, and the Hollow drowns in green.

epilogue.title: A Green Sea
epilogue.text: The moon comes down soft as a feather and breaks into a sea of green, and the whole Hollow sinks under the leaves.

epilogue.title: The Crooked Queen
epilogue.text: Kehlenn keeps her word the way a forest keeps a road: by growing over it.
